notes:
Prices & Orders update
Prices: new ➕ Add product. Pick a name from your reference sheet, type the vial size, paste the store links — every store shows together on one card (e.g. "BPC-157 · 5mg").
Order planner: new ⚡ Quick order. Choose products and a number of vials; the app compares every store and shows the best plans (cheapest, fewest orders, confirmed in stock) with sale notes and shipping.
New 🚚 Stores & shipping list: flat fee and "free over $X" per store, read from store pages where printed; you fill in only the gaps. Shipping is now saved in your data instead of the browser.
Sale notes are tidier: fine print like "how the sale works" is dropped and long banners are trimmed.
